description: This file defines the LogView class, a custom Android TextView that implements the LogNode interface to display log data visually within an app. It formats log messages, including priority, tags, messages, and exceptions, and appends them to the view, supporting chaining of LogNode objects.

classes.name: LogView
classes.description: A custom TextView that outputs log data received through the LogNode interface, formatting and displaying log messages within an Android application.

methods.name: println
methods.description: Formats log data including priority, tag, message, and throwable, then appends it to the LogView and passes the data to the next LogNode if configured.

methods.name: getNext
methods.description: Returns the next LogNode in the chain.

methods.name: setNext
methods.description: Sets the next LogNode in the chain.

methods.name: appendIfNotNull
methods.description: Appends a string to a StringBuilder with a delimiter if the string is not null or empty.

methods.name: appendToLog
methods.description: Appends a string as a new line to the LogView display.
